title: fix(llm): detect ADTS AAC headers with CRC

files.patch:
@@ -57,7 +57,7 @@ def infer_audio_type(audio_data: bytes) -> AudioMimeType:
         return "audio/mp3"
     elif audio_data.startswith(b"FORM") and audio_data[8:12] == b"AIFF":
         return "audio/aiff"
-    elif audio_data.startswith(b"\xff\xf1") or audio_data.startswith(b"\xff\xf9"):
+    elif audio_data.startswith((b"\xff\xf0", b"\xff\xf1", b"\xff\xf8", b"\xff\xf9")):
         return "audio/aac"
     elif audio_data.startswith(b"OggS"):
         return "audio/ogg"

@@ -294,7 +294,9 @@ def test_detects_every_mpeg_layer3_frame_header(self, header: bytes) -> None:
         assert isinstance(audio.source, Base64AudioSource)
         assert audio.source.mime_type == "audio/mp3"
 
-    @pytest.mark.parametrize("header", [b"\xff\xf1", b"\xff\xf9"])
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize(
+        "header", [b"\xff\xf0", b"\xff\xf1", b"\xff\xf8", b"\xff\xf9"]
+    )
     def test_adts_aac_is_not_mistaken_for_mp3(self, header: bytes) -> None:
         """ADTS AAC uses the reserved layer bits, so it stays AAC."""
         audio = Audio.from_bytes(header + b"\x50\x80" + b"\x00" * 8)
